title: A federated learning approach for edge heterogeneous environments
assignee: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

pse.problem: Federated learning algorithms in edge heterogeneous environments face problems such as data heterogeneity, device heterogeneity, and limited resources, which affect the accuracy and efficiency of model training.
pse.solution_function: The federated learning method proposed in this invention performs local model training on edge clients, partitions edge clients based on data distribution using a wavelet clustering algorithm, selectively involves edge clients in training, calculates weights for model aggregation, and saves the trained model.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes servers and edge clients. Edge clients perform local computations (CPU, GPU), and there's network communication between edge clients and servers.
pse.solution_implementation: In step S1, the server tests the CPU, GPU, and network status of each edge client and removes underperforming devices. In step S2, the wavelet clustering algorithm is used to partition the remaining edge clients based on data distribution. In step S3, the server selectively involves edge clients in training and performs model aggregation with calculated weights.
pse.effect: The proposed method addresses technical problems in prior art by realizing reliable federated learning task execution under limited resources in edge heterogeneous environments, improving model training accuracy and efficiency.
